subject: Request: Sandbox extension & credit support due to connector regression
messages:
From: Alex Gomez <alex@terrafold.ai>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sandbox access and timeline — need extension

Hi Priyom / Marissa,

Quick context: our connector team hit an unexpected regression when the SFTP adapter update rolled out this morning — it causes intermittent file truncation during ingest. Engineering just reproduced it and needs 5–7 business days to patch, plus another 2 days to re-run our validation suite. That pushes our demo and feature validation out of the current sandbox window.

Can Redwood extend our sandbox by 30 days and provide a small promotional credit pool (we estimate ~25K tokens of burst usage for end-to-end testing) so we don't lose our internal demo slot? We’re committed to the POC but this is purely an engineering timing issue.

Attaching a short connector-error log and the architecture diagram so you can see the flow that’s impacted.

Thanks — appreciate any help.

— Alex
Alex Gomez
CTO, TerraFold, Inc.
alex@terrafold.ai
+1 (415) 555-0136

Hi Alex — thanks for the quick heads up and for the logs. Sorry to hear about the SFTP regression; totally understandable.

Two things from our side: 1) We can authorize a time-limited sandbox extension scoped to the TerraFold POC, and 2) we typically grant promo token pools for integration QA when the blocker is on the customer's side — subject to a quick internal approval.

If you can confirm the expected ship date for the fix (even an approximate) I’ll start the internal approval flow and draft the extension terms. For planning, would you expect to need the extra headroom for 30 days from your existing expiry, or a 30-day window starting when you push the fix?

I’ll loop Karthik (revenue ops) and Marissa (AE) briefly for approval. If we can agree on a token amount and verification steps (e.g., limited to test endpoints, not production traffic), I should be able to get an answer today.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Approve 30d extension + promo tokens for TerraFold (HS-43210)

Marissa / Karthik — forwarded thread below from TerraFold. TL;DR: engineering regression on SFTP adapter; they need ~7 business days to patch and want to avoid losing their demo cadence.

Proposal for approval: 30-day sandbox extension starting from their current expiry date + 30,000 token promo earmarked for test endpoints only. Rationale: keeps the POC moving, low cost, good CS motion; deal is moving toward paid pilot. HubSpot shows $0 committed ARR but high engagement — we can trade a small promo for demonstration momentum.

Notes: we should require verification that the token use is for QA (SE-observed tests) and a sync at the end of extension to confirm progress. I can draft an email to Alex with the exact terms once you OK.

Cost estimate: worst-case draw = 30k tokens * $0.0006/token = $18.00 (note: token pricing is illustrative), net-of-biz-value is high because this preserves the demo slot.

Deal: HS-43210 — related hubspot link in the thread.

— Priyom

To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 12:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Approve 30d extension + promo tokens for TerraFold (HS-43210)

Thanks Priyom — fine to support with an extension, but let’s tighten the promo number. Approve a 30-day extension starting from their current sandbox expiry and a 25,000 token promo (test endpoints only). Please require SE sign-off for the QA sessions and a short post-extension recap call to confirm integration health before we make any additional concessions.

Karthik — please note for quota / promo tracking. Priyom, include an itemized line in HubSpot (promo token credit) so ops can reconcile usage.

— Marissa

Subject: Approved: 30-day sandbox extension + promo tokens (TerraFold HS-43210)

Hi Alex — quick update and confirmation.

We’ve approved the following for TerraFold (HS-43210):
- Sandbox extension: 30 days added to your existing sandbox expiry (no action needed from your side to accept).
- Promo token pool: 25,000 tokens allocated for use against test endpoints only.
- Preconditions: SE must be included in test sessions that draw on the promo pool. After the extension we’ll run a short 30-minute post-mortem sync to confirm the connector fix and discuss next steps toward the pilot.

I’ve added a HubSpot note (HS-43210) recording the promo allocation and a reconciliation request for Karthik. Karthik — please confirm when the promo is consumed or if we need to revoke for misuse.

If that works for you I’ll schedule an SE office hours slot for this Friday, 09/17 at 10:00 AM PT — Alex, does that still work for your eng lead?

Thanks — looking forward to getting you back on schedule.

Best,
